parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Meta information related to the transition owners. Values allowed are: transitionOwnerAgents, transitionOwnerTeams, transitionOwnerDept to include agents, teams, department under owners. You can pass multiple values by separating them with commas in the API request.

get.description: Retrieves the details of a specific blueprint including its states, transitions, connections, and chart configuration.

patch.description: Updates an existing blueprint with the specified configuration changes.

get.description: Checks whether a blueprint is associated with or applied to any entity (record). Use this before deleting or deactivating a blueprint to confirm it is not currently in use on tickets or other records.

post.description: Revokes the specified blueprint from all records it is currently applied to, removing it from the active execution flow.

Revokes the blueprint from multiple tickets simultaneously. Use this to bulk-remove blueprint enforcement from records. Pass up to 50 ticket IDs in the request body; IDs for which revocation failed are returned in failureIds.
To revoke blueprint from an entity
